correctness.rationale: The theorem is mathematically correct in the full-choice adaptive offered-vertex model. For triangle-free connected components, components with at most two edges have 0 or 2 closable vertices, while every component with at least three edges has v<=e+1<=4e/3. Thus a(G)<=4e(G)/3, with equality on disjoint 4-vertex paths. The one-step conditional success probability of any builder is at most 4j/(3n), and the product lower bound has logarithm -2m²/(3n)+O_L(n^-1/2). The constructive reserved-P4 strategy creates a full template per three productive offers, loses expected O(1) productive rounds by time O(sqrt(n)), and obtains the matching uniform error. Independent exhaustive simple-graph checks corroborated the exposure bound. This is an asymptotic optimal probability law, not finite-n exact optimality.
